## 3. Counterfactual (`npx tsx scripts/counterfactual.ts`)

Design: at every recorded timestamp where two wrappers have live quotes, buy $50 with three arms: **naive** (lowest token price), **random** (seeded control), **Tare** (most shares). Quotes more than five percent from the reference are excluded from every arm.

| Arm | Mean shares per $50 | Median |
|---|---:|---:|
| Naive | {{counter.arms.naive.meanShares}} | {{counter.arms.naive.medianShares}} |
| Random | {{counter.arms.random.meanShares}} | {{counter.arms.random.medianShares}} |
| Tare | {{counter.arms.tare.meanShares}} | {{counter.arms.tare.medianShares}} |

Observations: {{counter.observations}}. Tare minus naive: {{counter.tareMinusNaiveBps}} bps. Tare minus random: {{counter.tareMinusRandomBps}} bps.

Aggregator snapshot (keyed, contract as taker): picks differ in {{agg.differs}} of {{agg.groups}} groups; mean {{agg.meanTareOverNaiveBps}} bps, max {{agg.maxTareOverNaiveBps}} bps.

## 4. Break suite (`cd contracts && forge test`, BSC mainnet fork)

| Test | Fault | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| `test_unitJump` | Multiplier written down tenfold mid-order | Token baseline fills; Tare order reverts `ShareFloor` |
| `test_corporatePauseBStock`, `test_corporatePauseOndoOracle` | Issuer pause source reports paused | `UnitPaused` |
| `test_maliciousRecipient` | Route sends output to an attacker | Zero arrives, `ShareFloor` |
| `test_sandwich` | Pool price pushed before the fill | `ShareFloor` |
| `test_replay` | Same order filled twice | `NotOpen` |
| `test_unlistedRouter`, `test_wrongWrapper` | Router or wrapper outside the allowlist | `RouterNotAllowed`, `WrapperNotAllowed` |
| `testFuzz_noResidual` | Fuzz of order sizes | Book balance zero after each fill |
| `test_keeperCannotPassUnit` | Unit source moved under the same call | Outcome follows the on-chain unit |
| Invariant suite | Random place, cancel, fill sequences | T2, T6, T8 hold |

Result: {{forge.passed}} passed, {{forge.failed}} failed. Log: `evidence/fork/forge_test_full.txt`.

The replay does not show the on-chain floor catching more bad quotes than the off-chain guard. What it adds is that it holds while nobody is awake to sign.
